_comment: Tier-2: the runtime DEM wall SubModelPart must carry PROPERTIES_ID matching a material_relations entry in MaterialsDEM.json, because particle-wall contact-law lookup is by Properties Id. Pitfall (kratos.dem_structures_coupling #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). PROPERTIES_ID resolves on DEMApplication and NOT on core, and DemStructuresCouplingUtilities — the class whose TransferStructuresSkinToDem creates the wall part the claim describes — resolves on DemStructuresCouplingApplication. The value round-trips through ModelPart.SetValue/GetValue, which is the call the claim prescribes. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
